projects.name: Time as a Key (research paper)
projects.description: Preprint on a cryptographic flaw in the Rhysida ransomware: its PRNG is seeded with srand(time(0)) and the OAEP seed of its RSA key wrap comes from that same generator, making the blob appended to every encrypted file reproducible offline and usable as an exact oracle for a guessed key. Published by Sigreturn Labs, 15 pages.

projects.name: Polkadot Validators & Identity Registrar
projects.description: dotID, an independent identity registrar for the Polkadot and Kusama networks, built and operated by Sigreturn Labs. Its registrar seats and username authority were granted by on-chain governance, as registrar #5 on Polkadot and #7 on Kusama. It verifies the identity fields an account has set on-chain, records the corresponding judgement on the People Chain, issues .id usernames and publishes a directory of every verified identity. Previously, operation of validator nodes on the Polkadot NPoS consensus for about two years, since stopped.
